SELECT AVG(deals.amount_uzs / deals.volume_units * 1000) AS avg_price_per_kg_uzs
FROM deals_enriched deals
JOIN participants sellers ON deals.seller_inn = sellers.ИНН
JOIN participants buyers ON deals.buyer_inn = buyers.ИНН
JOIN brokers sellers_brokers ON deals.seller_broker = sellers_brokers.Код брокера
JOIN brokers buyers_brokers ON deals.buyer_broker = buyers_brokers.Код брокера
WHERE deals.product_name ILIKE '%хлопок-сырец%' 
AND deals.deal_date BETWEEN '2023-03-01' AND '2023-03-31'
AND deals.unit = 'килограмм'

SELECT 
    100 * SUM(T2.amount_uzs / T1.amount_uzs - 1) AS narxi_o'sish_holati
FROM 
    deals_enriched T1
JOIN 
    deals_enriched T2 
ON 
    T1.product_name ILIKE T2.product_name 
    AND T1.contract_form = T2.contract_form 
    AND T1.unit = T2.unit 
    AND T1.contract_type = T2.contract_type 
    AND T1.auction_type = T2.auction_type 
WHERE 
    T1.contract_date >= '2019-01-01' 
    AND T1.contract_date < '2020-01-01' 
    AND T2.contract_date >= '2020-01-01' 
    AND T2.contract_date < '2020-12-31'
